name: Otter
description: A model of Maritime Robotics' Otter, the 2 m electric catamaran USV, for the USV demos. One file drives the Blender generator (build_otter_blender.py -> otter.glb + otter_hydro.json) and the physics.

reference.vendor_figures: Product page (maritimerobotics.com/otter): 2000 x 1080 x 1065 mm, dry weight 62 kg, top speed 4.5 kn, endurance 20 h at 2 kn, payload capacity 30 kg, four interchangeable battery packs, two electric thrusters, 5 GHz MIMO radio / WiFi, camera, AIS class B; modules under 20 kg each, assembled by one person.
reference.geometry_source: No drawings are public. Every other number is read off the vendor's side render (otter-usv-side.png, 716 x 400) and front render (otter-usv-front.png, 428 x 400). The side render is close to orthographic: 3.18 mm/px (the 2.0 m pontoon over 629 px), which puts the vendor's 1065 mm between the thruster guards' feet and the tops of the gantry's antenna posts. The front render is a perspective from above the bow and gives the athwartships positions and the pontoon section, to a few centimetres. Treat anything not in vendor_figures as an estimate.
reference.assumed: Mass budget and loading conditions, thrust, sensor models and fields of view, the transducer position, where the thruster struts pass the pontoons, and the plan form of the fore frame (the front render shows a chevron; no view from above is public).

units: SI: metres, kilograms, newtons, seconds. Keys ending in _deg are degrees.

frame.origin: On the centreline, at the lowest point of the pontoon keel line (y = 0), halfway along the length overall (pontoon bows x = +1.0, sterns x = -1.0).
frame.appendages_below_baseline: The thruster guards reach y = -0.178 and the propeller tips y = -0.065.
frame.gltf: otter.glb is Y-up, same axes and metres as this frame. Node 'otter' is the root and sits at identity.

principal.height_note: Thruster guard feet (y = -0.178) to the gantry antenna posts (y = 0.887). The whip reaches y = 1.0.

pontoons.note: Two rotomoulded PE demihulls, 0.27 m wide and 0.345 m deep: a deep U section (front render), a banana keel line with the lowest point amidships (side render), a bluff round bow, and a stern that rises under the thruster and ends in a short raked transom. They narrow a little toward both ends.
pontoons.keel_profile_note: Keel line (x, y) from the side silhouette.
pontoons.stem_profile_note: Top of the pontoon forward of x = 0.9: the deck rounding down into the bow.

tow_eyes.note: The moulded-in holes near each end (side render), drawn as dark discs on the outer wall.

body.note: The electronics and battery pod between the pontoons, standing on their decks: a dark box under an aluminium deck plate, with an orange panel down each side that leans out from the deck edge to the pontoon's outer edge.

side_panel.note: Side view polygon (x, y): the forward edge is cut back and under, as the side render shows. z runs from z_bottom at y_bottom to z_top at y_top.

frame_tubes.note: Black 40 mm square tube at deck height, carrying the antennas and the thrusters. Aft: a cross beam at the pod's end, an arm over each pontoon to the thruster strut and beyond, and a cross bar with the aft GNSS antenna. Fore: a cross beam on two feet on the pontoon decks, arms converging to a short front bar (the chevron in the front render), and a centre spine with the fore GNSS antenna.

cable_loops.note: The thruster cables arch up from each pontoon deck ahead of the strut (both renders).

gantry.note: A-frame amidships: two plates leaning in from the deck edges to a top plate, a camera and electronics box under the plate, sidelights at its ends, and on top two antenna posts and an upright bracket with a small round camera.

sensors.convention: Empties look down local -Z with local +Y up (threepp/glTF camera convention). Positions in the vessel frame.

camera_main.assumed: hfov, resolution, fps, tilt; the lens is in the front of the box under the gantry's top plate

ais_vhf_antenna.note: Whip on the deck plate ahead of the gantry.

lte_antenna.note: The low black puck on the fore deck.

imu.assumed: inside the pod on the centreline

transducer.assumed: the sonar bay under the pod, between the pontoons; no geometry

thrusters.note: Two fixed electric pods (she steers on differential thrust), one under each pontoon's rising stern on a strut that comes down from the aft arm, each inside a tube guard from the keel to the transom. Node thruster_<side> sits at the pod on the strut axis and does not turn; thruster_<side>_rotor spins about its local +X.
thrusters.assumed: Thrust and power: a small electric outboard pod's order of magnitude, enough for the vendor's 4.5 kn; astern gives 60 % of it.

mass.note: Component budget: estimates that add up to the vendor's 62 kg dry weight. Centroids are where each component sits in this model. The generator recomputes the CoM and the hydrostatic equilibrium for each loading condition.

budget.item: pod, deck plate, side panels, frame tubes

mass.inertia_note: Radii of gyration (estimates): roll 0.40 B, pitch 0.26 L, yaw 0.27 L about the CoM.

extra.item: survey payload: echo sounder and its topside unit

hydrostatics.note: Computed by the generator from the buoyant closed meshes (the pontoons and the pod) by column integration of the winding number. The thruster pods and the guards are left out. Written to otter_hydro.json.

materials.note: Linear RGB. Colours read off the vendor renders, pulled toward plausible albedos.
